attributes.name: Mask of the Red Raven
attributes.powers:
If you are this card's Owner, when you encounter a monster, recharge this card to replace your character and token with the Red Raven's, then flip your role card if you have one.

When you encounter a monster, recharge this card to evade it, then end your turn.

On your Diplomacy or Stealth non-combat check, reveal this card and bury a boon from your hand or kit to add 1d8 plus the scenario's adventure deck number.
